edition: Paderewski / Bronarski / Turczynski (PWM): model-reviewed pitches, attacks, rhythm and dynamic levels; not a facsimile edition
provenance: Derived from the pinned NIFC Meissonnier fils encoding, corrected against the exact local Paderewski Mazurka scan; source originals retained
licence: Adapted from First Editions of Fryderyk Chopin's Music; Copyright 2017-2021 The Fryderyk Chopin Institute; https://nifc.pl; https://chopinscores.org; https://github.com/pl-wnifc/humdrum-chopin-first-editions; CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
verified_scope: notated rhythmic values and sounding durations
written small notes including trill endings
repeat signs and first/second ending labels
constant dynamic levels and their within-measure positions
omitted_or_unverified_scope: facsimile engraving and original clef placement
trill realization and grace-note timing variants
corrections: Restore the written two-small-note endings after every trill, including recurring D#5 (C-double-sharp5/D#5), G#4 (F#4/G#4) and F#5 (E#5/F#5) figures. The conversion retained only a few first occurrences.

Retain the initial five-sixteenth pickup (E4 sixteenth, A4 dotted eighth, C5 sixteenth) and the matching LH sixteenth/quarter rests; the first E4 is a full-size measured note, unlike the small E4 before measure 1.

Add the first-ending bracket at 28 and second-ending bracket at 29; move the lower-staff backward repeat from 36 to 37 to match both the upper staff and printed scan. Preserve forward repeats at 17 and 30.
Add the scan dynamic levels p/pp/mf/f and tempo/ritardando words. The pp/mf changes on the late pickups in 8/16/28/53 begin at quarter offset 1.75, not on the opening A5.
Preserve chromatic chord spellings in 32/33/36/37, independent A3/G#2 bass voices, key changes, later literal theme returns and the final two rests in 65.
